workarounds.symptom: Test suite is not hermetic in an installer-managed checkout: writes society DBs into <repo>/data and fails when .jarvis-managed-install exists (v2.9.0)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: keep the test suite out of the checkout's data dir. Target files: dodaios/core/config.py, dodaios/core/paths.py, dodaios/core/review/audit.py. #1095 pointed the suite at a temp `JARVIS_DATA_DIR`. A full local run with an audit hook on every write under `<repo>/data` found the stores that still ignored it. Each one now takes its default from the runtime data dir instead of a cwd-relative or hard-coded `data/`: (Ref: https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/pull/1119)

workarounds.symptom: [regression] Linux update to v4.1.x aborts at "dependency consistency check": pip check fails on system-site-packages otel exporters after opentelemetry floor bump (v4.1.2)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(installer): isolate headless Linux venvs and tolerate host-only pip check conflicts. Target files: install/installer.py, install/install.sh, tests/unit/install/test_install_sh_venv_isolation.py. Headless Linux installs linked the host's site-packages and resolved the runtime from the open pyproject ranges (`pip install -e .`), so pip took host copies of fastapi, uvicorn, opentelemetry and friends as "already satisfied" and the server ran on host versions (#456). The same linked site-packages made `pip check` judge packag... (Ref: https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/pull/1088)
